Since $2001$ is $3$ more than a multiple of six, we have \[\begin{aligned}a_1+a_2+\dots+a_{2001} &= a_1+a_2+a_3\\&=x+y+(y-x)\\&=2y = 2\cdot 493 = \boxed{986}.\end{aligned}\](Note that solving for $x$ was not strictly necessary.)
